user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 585 lux 到 748 lux
期望 温度 处于 16 ℃ 到 21 ℃
二氧化碳浓度 应 低于 10%
期望 湿度 处于 36 % 到 49 %
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() < 585 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() > 748 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() < 585 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() > 748 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() > 21 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_cooling_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() < 16 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_heating_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF mijia_CO2_ultra_sensor.get_CO2_concentration() > 10 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_humidity() > 49 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_dry_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_humidity() < 36 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_humidifier
IF viomi_hood.reading() >= 0.17 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN power_on() viomi_hood
